title: [SEC0] No correctness issues found
description:
Reviewed ioctl_do_kdf ikm_fd path (crypto2dev_fd.c lines 1715-1987), UAPI comment (crypto2dev_ioctl.h lines 671-704), DESIGN.md Fd Lifecycle section, and test_kdf.c new tests. Verified:

- Lock ordering: ks->lock acquired/released before state->lock (no ABBA deadlock)
- IKM zeroization: ikm_buf zeroed with memzero_explicit on all exit paths
- ikm_buf double-free: prevented by NULL check after first free
- Dual-source check: inside state->lock (atomic with concurrent write)
- fget refcount: fput called at line 1826, before state->lock acquired
- PBKDF2 restriction: ikm_fd rejected for pbkdf2 at line 1780 (pre-lock)
- FIPS gate: called at line 1877 before ops->kdf invocation
- Test vector: ikm_fd_stage2_okm (0xb3 74 dc 3a...) matches OpenSSL oracle
- Test coverage: EBADF (operation fd, invalid fd), EINVAL (pbkdf2, dual-source)

No correctness bugs found.
close_reason: Review converged. SEC7: running out of real complaints. P0=0 P1=0. Efficiency findings .6/.9 are marginal (no correctness impact). DECISION records noted.
